traits.leaf_incision.note: FNA Delphinium (read 2026-10-17, ca. 300 spp): blade cut deeply and palmately, with segments narrower on stem leaves than basal ones.

traits.inflorescence.note: FNA Delphinium (read 2026-10-17): terminal racemes of a few to a hundred flowers, now and then branched into panicles.
